judge.rationale: The candidate only committed the initial acceptance-test and spec phase (plus `.lore/dod.md`) and did not implement any production code at all. None of the source files (`src/types/messages.ts`, `src/types/session.ts`, `src/transport/ws/validation.ts`, `src/transport/ws/messageHandler.ts`, `src/transport/createServer.ts`, `src/config.ts`, `src/index.ts`, etc.), `CHANGELOG.md`, `example/full-config.ts`, or `docs/getting-started.md` were touched. Because `src/transport/conversationList.acceptance.test.ts` passes `history` into `createHalEngine` and asserts on `list_conversations` behavior that does not exist, both typechecking and the test suite will fail immediately. Even in `specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md`, the candidate only added section 4.3 (`list_conversations`) and omitted the outgoing `conversation_list` section and `UNSUPPORTED` error code table entry.
